name: JG_FSCL_ATTRB_DEF_TMPL_F
description: This table contains Fiscal Attribute Default Template values for Fiscal Document generation.

columns.name: FSCL_ATTRB_DEF_TMPL_ID
columns.description: Fiscal attribute default template identifier.

columns.name: FSCL_ATTRIB_TEMPLATE_CODE
columns.description: Name of the template against which the attribute values are setup.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the fiscal attribute default template setup is enabled for the event class and legal reporting unit. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: INDUSTRY_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the identifier for the industry for the transaction.

columns.name: DOC_NATURE
columns.description: Fiscal document nature. Possible values are 1 for standard, 2 for complementary, and 3 for adjustment.

columns.name: COMMITMENT_STMNT_CODE
columns.description: Default statement of commitment identification for government purchases to be informed to tax authority.

columns.name: PURCHASE_CONTRACT
columns.description: Default purchase contract information for government purchases to be informed to tax authority.

columns.name: PAYMENT_OPTION
columns.description: Default payment option of the transaction. Valid values are 0 for cash payment, 1 for installment payment, and 2 for others.

columns.name: FREIGHT_TYPE
columns.description: Default type of freight applicable to the fiscal document.
